answer: Force every newcomer through a narrow inlet: a single admission queue that drains at a fixed trickle rate, so a burst of clones simply waits instead of gaining strength. Once admitted, an agent occupies a terrace whose height is set by verified work and may rise only one step per epoch, never in a jump. Credentials are carved in marble, append-only, so a reputation band can never be reset or handed to another head; a clone inheriting a high terrace would betray itself through a carved history it cannot explain.
